steps.caption: Number of islands. Scan every cell; an unvisited '1' starts a new island. Then flood it so its other cells aren't counted again.
Land at (0,0) not visited yet: island #1. DFS over its 4-neighbours marks all 4 cell(s) as A.
Land at (1,3) not visited yet: island #2. DFS over its 4-neighbours marks all 1 cell(s) as B.
Land at (2,2) not visited yet: island #3. DFS over its 4-neighbours marks all 1 cell(s) as C.
Land at (3,3) not visited yet: island #4. DFS over its 4-neighbours marks all 2 cell(s) as D.
4 islands. Every cell is visited a constant number of times: O(m·n).
